lineage.description: Household-level GPS points and population counts were collected during the 2009 Vanuatu National Population and Housing Census using standard census enumeration methodology. Data are aggregated and georeferenced at multiple administrative levels (enumeration area, area council, province) to create a spatially-explicit population exposure dataset.
